messages:
emma_finance: Heads up — Lucentix (acct LU-342) invoice for Apr is unpaid. Amount due $78,450. ACH returned with R29 (account closed). Please don't suspend yet, coordinating.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2024-04-LU342 marked unpaid and dunning stage 1 initiated.

raj_ae: I talked to their CFO yesterday, they said finance is behind but promised a wire. I'm pinging them now.

emma_finance: They DM'd support with a screenshot saying they can wire $30k by Mon 03:00 PST and asked for installment plan for the remainder. Screenshot attached in ticket.

oliver_cs: From CS — their product usage is steady, high ROI. Risk of churn if we lock them out now.

jane_manager: Our handbook requires >=50% payment to avoid holds. $30k is ~38%. Need AE + legal signoff to make exception.

raj_ae: Understand. My ask: accept partial wire now and a 3-step paydown over 60 days. I'll secure a PO and signatures.

legal: We need a signed payment plan addendum. I'll draft a short amendment (1 page) and send to raj_ae. Also require a backup payment method on file.

emma_finance: Wire instructions to send (redacted):
```
Bank: ACME Bank
Acct name: Redwood Inference (placeholder)
Ref: LU-342-PAY
Amount: 30000 USD
Note: Please include INV-2024-04-LU342
```

billing-bot: /remind @finance to check wire clearance in 3 days

raj_ae: Lucentix asked for net-60 on remainder instead of 30-day splits. Any objections? They said they'd lose internal approvers otherwise.

jane_manager: Provisional approval: Accept $30k immediate; split remainder $48,450 into two payments: $24,225 due in 30 days and $24,225 due in 60 days. Conditions: signed addendum, PO on file, and card on file as backup. No late-fee waiver past final miss. If any payment missed, escalate to legal and consider service suspension.

collections: I'll mark account to prevent automated suspension for 7 days after wire clears. If second payment missed, we'll escalate on day+2.

emma_finance: I've updated the invoice notes and linked the support screenshot in accounting (INV-2024-04-LU342). Added internal tag: collections:pending-plan.

raj_ae: I'll send the addendum to the Lucentix finance contact and attach the PO. Expect return by EOD Mon.

emma_finance: Noted. Please cc @emma_finance and @legal on the signed doc. Once wire clears I'll update ledger and remove dunning holds.

billing-bot: Note added to thread: plan draft requested by legal.

raj_ae: :thumbsup: Getting verbal commit now.

emma_finance: Update — wire cleared: $30,000 received at 2071112700 UTC. Marking as partial payment and pausing automatic holds.

collections: Confirmed receipt. Paused suspension window for 7 days. Will monitor for next payment deadlines.

jane_manager: Great. Keep me posted if they delay the first scheduled installment. We'll treat any miss as breach of plan.

raj_ae: Will do. Thanks team.
